work_order.approach: Create the knowledge contracts as pure domain modules following the measurement.js pattern (no driver imports, {code,message,details} errors, integer micros, UTC ISO-8601, prefixed ids), persist behind repository interfaces with one additive migration, pin the browser criteria to deterministic seed fixtures, then surface thinly on the two existing pages with no new top-level screen. Order: src/strategy/router.js (ModelRouter with injected fake providers, version/token/latency/cost recording, optional second-provider critic) plus src/research/search.js (shared search interface with two fake adapters so IAC-1 is a constructor swap) plus src/research/sanitize.js (Browser Security Gateway wrapper and malicious classifier that drops content before any tool call) plus src/research/mesh.js (pure layered pipeline Layer0 first-party rows to Layer1 official to Layer2 search to Layer3 sanitized fetch to Layer4 browser-last-skip, with contentHash dedupe, Tier A-E scoring, source-independence corroboration, CONTRADICTORY detection, TTL cache) plus src/memory/learnings.js (validation, scope matching, candidate/accepted/contradicted/stale/rejected lifecycle mapped to KNOWN/BELIEVED/UNKNOWN/CONTRADICTORY/STALE/REJECTED claim states, gateForRetrieval enforcing scope plus freshness plus min confidence 0.60, contradiction merge retaining both sources, cosine similarity as ranking hint only with structured gate after). Then edit src/data/db.js with additive migration 003 (learnings and model_calls tables, both tenant-bound) and src/data/repositories.js with tenant-bound learning and call-log repositories, edit scripts/seed.js to write 2 accepted learnings (lrn_seed_1, lrn_seed_2) via the new learning repository plus deterministic evidence_refs/memory_refs on the 2 seeded decision payloads (idempotent on fixed ids), edit src/api/routes.js with GET /v1/learnings (tenant-scoped, deterministic sort, existing error envelope), and edit src/web/pages.js to read accepted learnings from the learning repository and render <section data-testid=research-observations> above the queue/empty-state whenever rows exist (true on the seeded boot) plus escaped evidence/memory refs spans on journal rows. Edits are additive only.
work_order.confidence_rationale: v1 rejection root-caused to missing seed fixtures (verified: runResearch/ModelRouter/gateForRetrieval//v1/learnings have no existing callers; seed writes decision.recorded x2 with no refs, one prose learning.recorded, zero opportunity.scored rows). v2 pins AC-6/AC-7 to deterministic seed rows written through the new repositories, so criterion and files[] describe the same boot.

work_order.understanding: Issue #21 builds the research-plus-memory knowledge layer: a model-router abstraction (TR-12), a layered research mesh with evidence tiers and claim lifecycle (TR-17), learning records with scope plus evidence refs plus effect intervals plus confidence plus status lifecycle with embeddings as retrieval assistance only (TR-10), and a prompt-injection boundary treating external web content as untrusted data isolated from the Executor (TR-11). The UI face adds no top-level screen: research observations feed the existing opportunities queue and evidence refs surface inside journal entries. Covers S-12, S-20, S-7, S-8. Binding owner decision from plan/brief.md: Meta Ads first, Google Ads after, which overrides the Google-first argument in spec section 37 — so this plan adds no Google provider. src/memory, src/research, and src/strategy do not exist yet; contracts are greenfield on established patterns (pure domain modules like measurement.js, fake-provider contract suites from the Meta adapter, tenant-bound repositories, five-state server-rendered pages). v1 was rejected because AC-6/AC-7 asserted seeded-boot visibility that no file produced: seed writes decision.recorded x2 with no refs, one prose learning.recorded, zero opportunity.scored rows (scripts/seed.js:64-86), while runResearch/ModelRouter have no callers (verified by grep); v2 fixes this by writing the asserted fixtures in scripts/seed.js and pinning both criteria to those exact ids.
